holidayPlanner.title: Holiday & Leave Planner
holidayPlanner.subtitle: Finds where to place your annual leave between Korean public holidays to get the longest breaks. Based on a Mon–Fri work week.

u.leaveHint: Pick how many annual leave days you can spend (1–15).

modeHint.total: Spreads your leave to get the most days off in total. On a tie, longer breaks win.
modeHint.long: Builds the single longest break first, then uses the rest for as many days off as possible.

u.skipPast: Skip dates that have already passed
u.workType: Assumes a Mon–Fri week with Korean public holidays (including substitute holidays) off. Public holidays are paid holidays at workplaces with 5+ employees.

tips.title: How to bridge holidays
items: Fill the 'bridge' weekday between a holiday and a weekend first. One leave day turns it into a 4–5 day break.
A Tuesday or Thursday holiday becomes a 4-day break with just Monday or Friday off.
Seollal and Chuseok are the most competitive. Request leave before your team's vacation schedule fills up.
Most holidays that fall on a Saturday get a substitute Monday (except New Year's Day and Memorial Day).
For a long trip, stack leave where holidays cluster (early May, early October) for the best days-per-leave ratio.

substitute.title: Substitute holiday rules
items: If the Seollal or Chuseok holidays overlap a Sunday or another holiday, the first weekday after them is a substitute holiday. Saturdays do not count.

Independence Movement Day, Constitution Day, Liberation Day, National Foundation Day, Hangeul Day, Buddha's Birthday, Children's Day, Christmas and Labor Day get the next weekday off if they fall on a weekend or another holiday.
New Year's Day, Memorial Day and election days have no substitute holiday.
Labor Day and Constitution Day became public holidays with substitute rules after the April 2026 amendment.

promotion.title: Leave-use promotion system
items: Six months before your leave expires, the employer may notify you of unused days and ask you to schedule them (Labor Standards Act Art. 61).
If you do not reply with dates within 10 days, the employer can set the dates up to two months before expiry.
If this process is followed and you still do not use the leave, you may not be paid for it. Plan early instead of saving it all for December.
Check how many leave days you have and what they are worth with the annual leave calculator.

method.title: How recommendations work
items: It finds every run of weekends and holidays, then tries filling the weekdays between them with leave or extending each run by a day or more.
'Most days off' picks the non-overlapping breaks with the largest total length within your leave budget.
'Best days' ranks breaks by days off per leave day and also shows a longer option for the same period.
Half days, company-specific days off and anniversaries are not included. If your company has extra days off, you get even more.

items.q: How many public holidays are there in 2027?
items.a: According to the 2027 calendar published by the Korea AeroSpace Administration, there are 72 public holidays including Sundays. A Mon–Fri worker gets 119 days off, and there are 10 breaks of 3+ days without any leave.

items.q: When should I take leave in 2027?
items.a: For Chuseok, take Sep 13 (Mon) and Sep 17 (Fri) to get 9 days off from Sep 11 to 19. For Seollal, 3 days (Feb 10–12) give 9 days (Feb 6–14). In May, one day on May 4 gives May 1–5, and in October, Oct 5–8 gives 10 days (Oct 2–11).

From the first to the last day of the break you build with leave, including weekends and holidays. Taking Friday off before a Saturday–Monday holiday weekend makes a 4-day break. The total is the sum of all breaks in the plan.

items.q: Do small companies also close on public holidays?
items.a: Since 2022, public and substitute holidays are paid holidays at workplaces with 5 or more employees (Labor Standards Act Art. 55). Smaller workplaces follow their own rules. Labor Day (May 1) is a paid holiday for all employees.

items.q: Can my employer refuse the dates I ask for?
items.a: Leave should be granted when the employee requests it. The employer may change the timing only if it would seriously disrupt business (Labor Standards Act Art. 60(5)). Request peak-season leave early.

items.q: How do I use the .ics file?
items.a: 'Add to calendar' saves an .ics file with each suggested leave day as an all-day event. Import it in Google Calendar settings, or open the file on your phone to add it to your calendar.
Yes, once the government designates one. No temporary holiday has been designated for 2027 yet; if one is, recommendations may change.
